podcasts.title: Agents That Think Together: Cisco's Vijoy Pandey on Semantic Alignment, Scope, Accord & Concord
podcasts.description: Vijoy Pandey, SVP and GM of Outshift by Cisco, discusses the challenges of multi-agent systems and Cisco's new open-source protocols designed to help AI agents collaborate effectively. He explains how tools like Scope, Accord, and Concord address semantic misalignments, intent negotiation, and cognitive failures across complex workflows. The conversation also dives into personal agent setups, avoiding model lock-in, and the rise of latent space communication. Finally, Pandey shares why proper guardrails will ensure humanity benefits as autonomous systems grow in complexity. podcasts.name: The a16z Show
podcasts.title: What the Internet Boom Teaches Us About the AI Buildout | Mike Volpi
podcasts.description: The internet boom built bandwidth. The AI boom is building intelligence. Mike Volpi, who helped shape Cisco’s strategy during the internet buildout, asks what that era can teach us about this one. Mike joins a16z’s Raghu Raghuram and Guido Appenzeller to compare today’s investment in GPUs, data centers, and power with the fiber boom of the late 1990s, and explain why the infrastructure could prove valuable even if the market corrects. They also discuss NVIDIA, custom silicon, networking, and the changing economics of GPUs, plus lessons from Cisco’s acquisition machine. And Mike explains why he thinks this technology cycle could be even more consequential than the last.
